mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month and SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for two consecutive months and SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% in a month and SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by more than 1% in a month and SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month and SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL YoY growth), it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds CPIAUCSL YoY growth, but SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
